title: Yeasty Gooey American Bread Bake
description: Soft, buttery bread rolls with a gooey center, perfect for a lazy Sunday brunch.
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, and yeast in a large mixing bowl.
Add warm water and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving 2 inches of space between each roll.
Brush the tops of the rolls with egg wash and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove the rolls from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes.
Split each roll in half horizontally using a serrated knife.
Place the rolls under the broiler for 1-2 minutes or until the centers are golden brown and gooey.
Remove the rolls from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
